_README: Label id -> structure name for the Visible Human FEMALE suprahyoid / infrahyoid / extrinsic tongue volume (scripts/cryo/vhf_hyoid_muscles_from_cryo.py), plus the mapping onto atlas entities. A KEY, not data. rule-based: markers by position rules relative to her mandible, hyoid, larynx, styloid and tongue labels, boundaries by marker watershed on the pale septa of her cryosection photographs; sinks and compartments are mapped to null.
source: U.S. National Library of Medicine, The Visible Human Project (public domain), female colour cryosections (1 mm frame) and CT via the NCI Imaging Data Commons; TotalSegmentator v2.18.0 `total`, `headneck_muscles`, `headneck_bones_vessels`, `head_muscles` (tongue, digastric) and `craniofacial_structures` (mandible) labels as anchors. Rules from Standring S (ed.), Gray's Anatomy, 42nd ed., ch. 29 'Neck' and ch. 30 'Oral cavity', and Moore KL et al., Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed., ch. 8 'Head' and ch. 9 'Neck'. Derived data (scripts/cryo/vhf_hyoid_muscles_from_cryo.py), rule-based.

not_attempted.intrinsic_tongue: superior / inferior longitudinal, transverse and vertical muscles: no septa at 1 mm; carried in the tongue_intrinsic sink
not_attempted.palatoglossus: a 1-2 mm fold; out of scope
not_attempted.palate_and_pharynx: out of scope (the constrictors are shipped from the CT task)
not_attempted.omohyoid_inferior_belly: a 2-3 mm band across the posterior triangle in fat at 1 mm; not attempted
not_attempted.digastric: already shipped from the head_muscles CT task (ct_vhf_headm); its label is excluded here
not_attempted.sternothyroid_thyrohyoid: shipped from the CT task (ct_vhf_neck); their labels excluded, the deep strap layer is a sink

sternohyoid_right.note: 2.7 cm3; rule-based: position-rule marker relative to her mandible / hyoid / larynx / tongue labels, boundary by the marker watershed on her fascial septa.

omohyoid_right.note: 3.8 cm3; rule-based: superior belly and its course under the SCM; the inferior belly across the posterior triangle is not attempted.

styloglossus_right.note: 1.8 cm3; rule-based: corridor from the styloid process to the side of the tongue and the lateral posterior side of the tongue label.

stylohyoid_right.note: 2.3 cm3; compartment: stylohyoid + posterior belly of the digastric (one band from the styloid / mastoid to the hyoid at 1 mm; the stylohyoid splits around the digastric tendon) -- at ~2 cm3 it is 2-3x a stylohyoid; mapped to null, candidates listed.

deep_strap_right.note: 5.8 cm3; NOT shipped: sink for the deep strap layer (sternothyroid / thyrohyoid, shipped from the CT task as ct_vhf_neck; their CT labels are also excluded); keeps that layer out of the sternohyoid.

floor_lateral_right.note: 4.9 cm3; NOT shipped: sink for the anterolateral floor lateral of the geniohyoid / genioglossus (sublingual region, lateral genioglossus fibres); not a target.

tongue_intrinsic_right.note: 14.1 cm3; NOT shipped: sink for the intrinsic tongue (superior / inferior longitudinal, transverse, vertical) and the palatoglossus: no septa at 1 mm, out of scope.
